groups.title: CNC Machining
groups.summary: Renshaw Dynamics provides precision CNC machining for one-off protypes, low-volume work, and production runs.
groups.intro: Renshaw Dynamics provides precision CNC machining for one-off protypes, low-volume work, and production runs. Using advanced multi-axis CNC equipment, we manufacture complex, tight-tolerance components to customer drawings and specifications for a wide range of industries.

groups.title: CMM & Metrology
groups.summary: We provide precision CMM inspection and metrology services for customer-supplied components.
groups.intro: We provide precision CMM inspection and metrology services for customer-supplied components. Using advanced CMM equipment, we perform dimensional inspection, part verification, and GD&T inspection to evaluate components against customer drawings and specifications. Upon completion, customers receive a detailed dimensional inspection report documenting the measured results, providing clear, traceable data for their records and quality requirements.

about.title: Built by two brothers who love manufacturing.
text: Renshaw Dynamics was founded by two brothers with a shared passion for manufacturing and solving complex problems.
We deliver precision-machined components and dimensional inspection services with reliability, consistency and attention to detail.
Every project starts the same way: we understand your requirements, execute with precision, and deliver work that meets the highest standards.
